basic_info.description: This stunning 17th-floor apartment offers unparalleled panoramic views of the city, including the iconic Golden Gate Bridge. Spanning approximately 1,120 square feet, this elegant residence features a spacious one-bedroom with an en suite bathroom, a welcoming living and dining area, a kitchen with a view, a full guest bathroom, in-unit laundry area, and a large closet room with window that has a built-in Murphy bed, very convenient when you have guest that needs to stay overnight. Additional perks include a private storage in the basement and a designated parking spot in the building's secure garage.    Residents of the Clay-Jones Building enjoy exclusive access to a rooftop deck, restricted to Owners, Tenants, Employees, and Guests, perfect for relaxing or entertaining while taking in breathtaking views. The building also provides 24/7 doorman service for enhanced security and convenience.    Notably, the homeowner's association fees are kept low thanks to income generated from the building's rooftop antenna and the restaurant located on the ground floor, making this property as practical as it is luxurious.
